script: Not because the second author was smarter.

props.description: The exact same sentence falls like a seed onto two soils: 2019 is dry cracked ground where it bounces off and dies; 2022 is dark tilled soil where the identical seed sinks in and sprouts. Same seed, different readiness. Camera pulls between the two patches to show the only variable that changed is the ground.

script: Nobody wills themselves into readiness by reading faster.
